text:
Ana: Heads up — drafting final recovery/status note for affected onboarders (EU region). Need quick alignment on customer-facing wording, credits, and two follow-ups: a live enablement office hour and a short feedback survey. Issue summary: embeddings ingestion job failed during nightly batch window; some customers saw incomplete indexes and 502s for embed lookup. Proposing 48 hours credit + 1:1 enablement for high-touch accounts. Draft below.

Matt: +1. Can we get a list of 'high-touch' affected accounts? I want to prioritize outreach for renewals. Also need to know if any contracts have SLA clauses that trigger refunds beyond credits.

Priya: I can pull the list now — filtering by onboarding_start >= 2025-10, priority_tier != "self-serve", and errors.count > 5. Expect list in ~45m. For enterprise, recommend we offer a custom make-good (config + enablement) instead of blanket credits.

Jules: Legal — please review the draft wording for refund implications. We should avoid language that implies admission of SLA breach unless Legal signs off. Suggest: replace "we will refund" with "we will apply a credit".

CS Bot: incident-3457 status update: root cause identified (failed ingestion job due to malformed batch). Mitigation: rollback and reindex completed 2026-03-21T09:12Z. Customers affected: 28 onboarders (EU).

Ana: Draft customer note (short):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re reaching out with an update on a recent platform issue that affected embeddings during onboarding. Between 2026-03-20 01:00 UTC and 2026-03-20 06:00 UTC a data ingestion job failed for a subset of onboarding jobs, which caused incomplete search/semantic results and returned 502s for some API calls.

What we’ve done: re-ran the ingestion, re-indexed affected datasets, and added extra validation to the batch pipeline. The service is restored.

What we’re offering: a 48-hour account credit applied within 5 business days and an invitation to a 1:1 enablement session to review your integration and ensure data quality.

If you’d like to opt in for the enablement session or need a different remediation, reply to this message and we’ll schedule.

Thanks,
The Redwood Success Team
```

Matt: Draft looks good. For renewal-risk accounts, add: "we'll schedule a technical follow-up within 3 business days" and offer an executive touchpoint if requested.

Priya: noted. I'll tag each high-touch tenant in the outreach and route the enterprise offers through AE/SEs. Will include a short feedback ask: 3 quick questions to capture impact and ease of recovery.

Jules: Legal: quick response? If you approve the adjusted phrasing, we can send this out today. Also confirm any mandatory reporting for enterprise contracts.

Legal: Reviewed — approve the phrasing with the credit language. For any account that references a specific SLA clause in writing, escalate to me before sending.

Ana: Thanks — plan: Priya sends list + owner mapping in 45m, Matt & I will mark renewal-risk accounts, Jules/legal check done, CS Bot incident note posted. Sending timeline: outreach by EOD (EU timezone), office hours scheduled for Friday.

Matt: :thumbsup: Ping me when list is up. I’ll prepare exec summaries for 3 highest-risk renewals.

Priya: List posted to the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/drive/onboard-embeddings-incident (access: cs,ae,se). I tagged owners for each account.

Ana: Perfect. After outreach we should collect feedback and a quick NPS-ish pulse (1-5 severity + brief comment). I’ll follow up with a feedback template.

Jules: Also recommend we log this as a post-incident customer-impactable item for the monthly CS-RCA review.

Ana: Agreed — adding to agenda. Thanks team.

(End of thread)
